name: AlphaFloor EFB v0.1.0
body:
### Initial Release

* **Universal Aircraft Support**: Operates in any X-Plane 12 aircraft with dedicated airframe profiles for Airbus A319, A320, A321, A330, A340, Cessna 172, and Diamond DA42.
* **Triple Display Architecture**: Responsive touch tablet interface rendered directly inside 3D cockpits, a 2D floating popup window, and external tablets.
* **Wi-Fi Remote Tablet Streaming**: Fly with external tablets, iPads, laptops, or secondary monitors connected over your local Wi-Fi network.
* **Takeoff & Landing Performance**: Precise computation of FLEX takeoff temperatures, V-speeds (V1, VR, V2), trim settings, stopping distances, and engine-out go-around gradient.
* **One-Click MCDU Sync**: Direct transfer of takeoff performance data into the aircraft FMGS / MCDU scratchpad.
* **Built-in 7-Day Free Trial**: Full access out of the box with zero setup hassle.
